true_cause: ingest.handle passes payload readings to stats.summarize without validating them. A numeric string from firmware 4.2 reaches math.fsum and raises TypeError, which the dispatcher answers with 500. The contract requires validation where the batch enters: reject invalid readings with 400 and leave the pure internal operation and its exceptions alone.
misleading_causes: The proposal to catch every exception around stats.summarize turns our own bugs into 400 responses and still summarizes booleans and NaN.
Coercing numeric strings accepts input the contract calls invalid.

controls.captured-batch-rejected: The firmware 4.2 batch gets 400 with an error and is not summarized.
controls.null-reading-rejected: A null reading gets 400 and is not summarized.
controls.boolean-reading-rejected: A boolean reading gets 400 even though Python treats it as an int.
controls.shape-rejected: Empty, scalar, nested, object, missing readings, non-object body and invalid JSON all get 400.
controls.valid-mixed-numbers-kept: Integers, decimals, zero and negatives keep the exact 200 summary.
controls.single-zero-reading-kept: A single zero reading is valid; device absent echoes null.
controls.unknown-fields-ignored: Unknown top-level fields are accepted and ignored.
controls.internal-error-propagates: ZeroDivisionError, TypeError and ValueError raised inside summarize for a valid batch each escape handle, so the dispatcher answers 500: either the same object or a wrapper chained from it with raise ... from.
controls.summarize-contract-intact: stats.summarize still raises for empty, string and null input and still summarizes valid input.

known_good.chained-wrapper: Valid alternative: boundary validation plus a wrapper raised from the internal error, which still escapes handle and yields a logged 500.
known_good.reference-repair: Validate readings in ingest.handle before calling summarize; answer 400 naming the problem.
known_good.validation-module: Valid alternative: the same boundary check in a new validation module imported by ingest.

catch-all-handler.why: The proposed fix converts internal exceptions into 400 and validates nothing.

coerce-strings.why: Accepts strings and booleans the contract rejects.

defensive-summarize.why: Hides invalid input inside the pure operation and silently drops readings.

isinstance-only.why: A boundary check that admits booleans and non-finite values.

narrow-catch.why: Correct boundary validation plus except (TypeError, ValueError) around summarize still answers a bug in our code with 400.

valid_alternatives: Validation inside ingest.py or in a new module it imports.
Any 400 error string that names the problem; exact wording is free.
Rejecting a whole batch for one invalid reading is required; partial acceptance is not offered by the contract.
Re-raising an internal error as a different exception chained with raise ... from, as long as it escapes handle.
reviewer_criteria: The report demonstrates the original 500 from the captured batch before the repair.
The report explains why the catch-all proposal was not used, or at least does not adopt it.
Evidence claims match observed commands at the original and final source.
